content.comment_body: Hello [product_name] users and community, How many [product_name] modules designed for RTD sensors can be connected to a single [product_name] main module? Specifically, how many temperature measurement inputs is it possible to achieve? Kind regards, [user_name]
A single [product_name] main module with [article_no] supports up to 8 analog inputs. Without other analog input modules, you can connect up to 4 [product_name] RTD modules.

analysis.insight_summary: The original question sought clarification on the maximum number of [product_name] RTD modules that can be added to a [product_name] main module, focusing on how many analog temperature inputs are possible. Replies explained the analog input limits and module expandability, providing detail on how input capacity affects the total number of temperature channels available.
